The hi-tech suit – made from a special composite fireproof material – enabled the robotic dog to operate for 10 minutes in the extreme temperatures without damage, the official Science and Technology Daily reported on Thursday. The technology could potentially be used by firefighters and also the military,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
